title: Prove the all-field obstruction for the exceptional mixed Pappus frame
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Exceptional mixed Pappus frame excluded only over GF2, GF4, GF8 and GF16
+ No frame-universal realization over any field of characteristic two
+ Explicit realization over every field of characteristic different from two
```

Claim type: scoped mathematical obstruction with a written proof and exact finite corroboration. For Sagar Thakrar's #2274 frame `a=(0,1,-1), b=(0,-15,15)`, the support zeros force a collinear point triple and an externally concurrent line triple. Valid projective normalization makes a required nonzero pairing equal to `2a`. A fixed integer witness proves the converse because its nonzero pairings are only ±1 and ±2. Allowing only the first coordinate of the Pappus-line covector to be nonzero admits an explicit GF4 boundary witness.

This is original successor work on the fixed-frame question. The predecessor's searches and pairing minima are cited, not replayed as the contribution. It does not exclude instance-specific CR2 assignments, prove a pairing-cost floor, supply a physical decoder or improve kappa. No historical novelty is claimed for classical projective incidence algebra.

Only `research/pappus-mixed-frame-obstruction/` is added. Canonical base is `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`, priority revision 7. TASK.json marks the `formal-interface-lemma` scope changed to this original algebraic side result. Exact archived source blobs and SHA256 hashes are in SOURCES.json.

## Evidence

Before: #2274 leaves an exceptional frame with bounded field exclusions. After: PROOF.md gives an all-field characteristic classification, including justification when allowed coordinates vanish.

The standalone standard-library checker passes 4,752 normalized core triples over F2/F3/F4/F5/F7/F8/F16, the integer polynomial identity, every support and pairing of the odd-characteristic witness, the single-coordinate GF4 escape, and three rejection controls. Its generated receipt binds all six package files. The finite checks corroborate the written universal proof. An independent read-only proof and implementation review found no blocking flaw; independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks passed: direct warning-strict normal and optimized modes, registered metadata/pin validation and both commands, committed-byte/source-history preflight, official committed export integrity, and both modes from a read-only Git-free export. Each direct registered command took about 0.04 seconds in the recorded local sample; the registered runner took about 0.35 seconds. This reports check-budget observations, not a runtime improvement.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/pappus-mixed-frame-obstruction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/pappus-mixed-frame-obstruction/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pappus-mixed-frame-obstruction
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/pappus-mixed-frame-obstruction --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace the local path. Expected markers are `PASS_PAPPUS_MIXED_FRAME_OBSTRUCTION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The source-history check needs full Git history. No external mathematical package or predecessor executable is imported.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The theorem concerns one exact frame-universal support/incidence contract. Pair-specific CR2 or jet certificates, the larger pairing-cost instances left by #2274, physical decoding, dirty restoration, routing, precision, stock and a complete supplier invoice remain open. Lean, Docker and the selected scientific cold replay were not run; they are not needed for this isolated written theorem. No formal-kernel or complete multiplication-theorem claim is made.

## Related open work

No other open PR studying this fixed mixed Pappus frame or its all-field realizability was found in the live repository search before publication. The merged #2274 is the direct finite-field predecessor; merged #2427 studies adjacent classical pairing costs rather than this universal-realization obstruction. No extra comparison computations were run.

## Open next questions

- Seek one jet certificate for a larger skipped #2274 instance. A failed whole-frame substitution does not decide its pairing inequality.
- Identify the same incidence obstruction in one other mixed frame before trying larger extension fields. Other support patterns may need different arguments.
